title: Unresolved dynamic React element tags bypassed native-element isolation checks

examples: import React from 'react'; const tag: string = resolveTag(); React.createElement(tag, { src: remoteUrl });
A React factory whose element type has an unresolved string, any, or unknown type
reproduction.beforeFix: The source gate returned pass for React.createElement(resolveTag(), ...) because the tag resolver returned no known tag and the scanner treated the empty result as safe.
reproduction.afterFix: The gate rejects a React factory when its tag cannot be statically resolved and its type could be an intrinsic string tag. Statically known custom component types remain eligible for normal scanning.

rootCause: The factory scanner applied script, iframe, and resource-prop checks only to resolved tag names. An empty resolution for an any/string/unknown tag did not produce a diagnostic.
remediation: Use the TypeScript checker to detect unresolved factory tags that could be intrinsic string elements, then fail closed rather than certifying the missing classification as safe.
